channel.title: 556678.com — Guides
channel.description: Count In Your Growth: guides for founders and small businesses.

item.title: Why Profitable Businesses Still Run Out of Cash (and How to Stop It)
item.description: Cash flow, not profit, decides whether a small business survives. A practical system for forecasting, collecting faster and building a buffer.

item.title: Break-Even Analysis in Plain English: The First Number Every Founder Needs
item.description: How to calculate your break-even point, why contribution margin matters, and how to use break-even to set prices and goals.

item.title: Pricing for Profit: A Small-Business Playbook
item.description: Cost-plus, competitor and value-based pricing explained, plus tiering, anchoring and how to raise prices without losing customers.

item.title: How to Win Your First 100 Customers
item.description: A step-by-step plan for early traction: direct outreach, communities, partnerships, referrals and content that compounds.

item.title: AI for Small Business: Where It Pays Off First
item.description: Practical, low-risk ways for small teams to use AI for support, marketing, admin and sales — plus how to measure the return.

item.title: Small-Business Funding Options Compared: Bootstrapping, Loans, Grants and Investors
item.description: An honest comparison of the main ways to fund a small business, with the real costs, trade-offs and who each option suits.

item.title: The 8-Count Launch Checklist: From Idea to First Sale
item.description: Eight beats, in order, that take a business idea from notebook to first paying customer — with the tools for each step.

item.title: Unit Economics for Non-Finance Founders: LTV, CAC and Payback
item.description: Understand the three numbers that tell you whether growth makes you money or burns it — with worked examples.
